posts.name: Livin Nector
posts.cooked:
Max and min also just selects the value.

What aggregation does is takes collection of values as input and returns a single value. Any function that does this is an aggregation function.

def select_first(items):
  for item in items:
    return item

def select_last(items):
  for item in items:
    pass
  return item

As you can see, you can implement these functions with a loop based implementation also you can implement these with reduce based implementations.

from functools import reduce

select_first = lambda x: reduce(lambda a,b: a, x)
select_last = lambda x: reduce(lambda a,b: b, x)

Thus these are adhering to the aggregation logic.
